Two problems. One hard crash.

## 1. Crash — line 247

```
TypeError: Embed.set_footer() takes 1 positional argument but 2 were given
```

`set_footer` is keyword-only: `(self, *, text=None, icon_url=None)`. `/level` throws before `ctx.send` — no embed at all. `set_author`/`set_thumbnail` accept positional-ish but footer never does. Fix:

```python
embed.set_footer(text=f"{rank_text}`{xp:,}xp` total")
```

## 2. Backticks won't render in a footer

Discord footers strip markdown — no bold, no italics, no code spans, no auto-links. `` `1,234xp` `` prints the backticks literally. Same for the `**` you removed from the title — irrelevant, but know the footer can't be styled. Want code styling → put XP in the description (it already is) or a field.

Also: footer max 2048 chars, and `text` + `icon_url` need the URL as a kwarg too.

## 3. Cosmetic dead ends

- `total` from `rank, total = db.get_rank(...)` now unused (rank_text dropped it). Harmless, ruff would flag.
- Dropped `set_author` → when someone runs `/level member=@other`, card has no name anywhere. Title is `Level 7`, thumbnail is a 70px avatar. Consider keeping author, or name in title: `title=f"{target.display_name} — Level {lv}"`.
- `rank_text = f"ranked #{rank} · "` has trailing separator — with the backticks going literal you get `ranked #3 · \`1,234xp\` total`. Reads fine. When `xp == 0` → `rank` is 0 (`src/db.py:100`), so footer collapses to `` `0xp` total``. Fine, intentional-looking.

`cooldown_text` removal clean — no dangling refs. Bar/percent/`xp to level N!` block compiles and behaves.
